title: In SoCal …
excerpt: I had a wonderful time at a Beatitudes Society banquet in Santa Barbara at Trinity Episcopal Friday night, and I’ll be in Claremont this evening with a public presentation at Mudd Theatre at 7 pm. Hope to see you there!
